# assets.dat Record 8: Certificate Serial-Number Table

File: `records/08_keystore_attestation_serial_blocklist.bin`  
Size: `23650` bytes  
SHA-256: `9fb6717c63e059afdbb9771defb03caaf7539a25e089dea44cac037bf1643e6e`

This is the final plaintext of assets.dat record 8. The native loader
`FUN_0014e774` authenticates the record with ChaCha20-Poly1305 and stores
the buffer in `_DAT_001a8130`. `FUN_0014e90c` searches that buffer with a
binary search keyed on the DER INTEGER contents of an X.509 certificate
serial number. A hit returns `flag | 0xffffff80`; a miss returns `0`.

## Format

```text
+0  uint32  declared payload size (must equal the file size)
+4  uint32  group count
+8  group header: uint32 key_length, uint32 row_count
    row: key_length key bytes + one policy flag byte
```

Groups are bucketed by exact key length. Every group is strictly sorted
lexicographically and has no duplicate keys. All shipped flag bytes are
`0x00`, so this is currently a pure membership blocklist.
